FaultSeverityEnum.description: DATEX II FaultSeverityEnum — inherited via Fault base (PDF §3.3).

TrafficSignalFault.description: Traffic signal fault reports with flattened DATEX II Fault base (TS004.0064bis:2017 §3.3, F6).

trafficSignalId.description: Identifier of the traffic signal this fault applies to.
trafficSignalId.title: ObjectId

faultTypeId.description: Reference to a FaultTypeDefinition entry. The catalogue carries the code, category and message template; new fault types are added as catalogue entries, with no schema change. Required unless trafficSignalFaultType is given; when both are present this is the authoritative classification.
faultTypeId.title: TypeId

trafficSignalFaultType.description: Coarse DATEX II fault bucket, as in TS004.0064bis:2017. Required unless faultTypeId is given; when both are present faultTypeId is the authoritative classification.

faultCreationTime.description: Time the fault was first recorded.

trafficSignalManufacturerFaultCode.description: A supplier unique identifier for this specific fault.

parameters.description: Values for the positional placeholders in the referenced FaultTypeDefinition's messageTemplate, in order. Rendered as text so a value carries whatever form the fault reports it in.

extensions.description: Vendor or forward-compatibility extensions. Open-content object.

TrafficSignalFault.title: UTMC Traffic Signal 0064 Fault

UrgencyEnum.description:
DATEX II UrgencyEnum — inherited by TrafficSignalFault.trafficSignalFaultUrgency (PDF §3.3).

``UNKNOWN`` is a deliberate addition to the DATEX II baseline: a
publisher that cannot determine urgency must be able to say so rather
than defaulting to ``normalUrgency`` and understating a fault. This
mirrors ``FaultSeverityEnum.UNKNOWN``, which already carries the value.
